description: This script fuses Google Test source code files into combined header and source files, gtest.h and gtest-all.cc, for easier integration and distribution.

methods.name: VerifyFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists in a directory, aborts if not.

methods.name: ValidateGTestRootDir
methods.description: Validates that the provided root directory contains necessary gtest files.

methods.name: VerifyOutputFile
methods.description: Checks if an output file exists and prompts for overwrite permission.

methods.name: ValidateOutputDir
methods.description: Validates the output directory for writing files.

methods.name: FuseGTestH
methods.description: Generates a fused gtest.h header file by recursively processing include directives.

methods.name: FuseGTestAllCcToFile
methods.description: Generates a fused gtest-all.cc source file by recursively processing include directives.

methods.name: FuseGTestAllCc
methods.description: Creates the gtest-all.cc file in the output directory.

methods.name: FuseGTest
methods.description: Main function to fuse gtest.h and gtest-all.cc files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, determines which fuse functions to run.
